Q: Scan directories and copy those that have more than n files A:

find is quite convenient for this kind of things. We can use it to find all album directories in the music directory, let a small bash script execute on each found directory to test the number of files and copy (with rsync) the directory to destination if it is large enough. In the following we copy only if there are 7 files or more, and the destination directory is /media/sdcard. Adapt to your needs:

find . -mindepth 2 -type d -exec bash -c 'a=("$1"/*); ((${#a[@]} >= 7)) && rsync -a "$1" "/media/sdcard/$1"' _ {} \;

Note: different from other solutions (including the accepted one) this works even if the name of some of your files contain spaces, newlines or other special characters.

Q: Unable to Publish Azure Data Factory Publish A:

This issue is commonly caused by a mismatch between Data Factory mode and Git mode. It may happen when Git is first configured, or when changes are added directly in Git or in Live mode.

If you are unable to find and fix the conflict manually, you may re-sync the content in the Git Configuration page, by using either:

  • Overwrite Live Mode (which I recommend): Makes Data Factory mode (published) version match Git.
  • Import Resources: Makes a Git branch match Data Factory mode.

Please be advised that overwriting live mode may result in losing changes not currently in Git. You may use Import Resources to persist changes prior to this.

Q: Spring - Stop a background task running on port 8080 A:

  • Open the cmd and try to run it as Adminstrator

  • And run the command taskkill /PID <PID> /F /T

Q: Send Mail from Windows Machine using Shell ( from Git bash) A:

The PowerShell part only needs the HTML body flag. Read the file as one string and pass -BodyAsHtml:

$body = Get-Content -Path 'C:\Users\xyz\Documents\failed_cloud_alert\missJobMailer.txt' -Raw

Send-MailMessage `
    -To 'recipient@example.com' `
    -From 'sender@example.com' `
    -Subject 'TEST' `
    -Body $body `
    -BodyAsHtml `
    -SmtpServer 'smtp.example.com'

Without -BodyAsHtml, the message is sent as text/plain, so the recipient sees the HTML source. Also make sure the file contains a complete HTML document (or at least valid HTML markup).

Git Bash does not provide /usr/sbin/sendmail; it is a collection of Unix-like tools for Windows, not a complete Linux installation. From Git Bash you can invoke Windows PowerShell explicitly, for example:

powershell.exe -NoProfile -File 'C:\path\to\send-alert.ps1'

For new code, note that Send-MailMessage is obsolete. A maintained SMTP library such as MailKit is a better long-term choice; whichever client is used still needs the SMTP host's required authentication, TLS and port settings.

There is another option when the goal is to send through an already configured desktop mail client instead of configuring SMTP in the shell script. If Pegasus Mail is configured and running in the same signed-in Windows session, Pegasus Bridge can accept a local authenticated request and hand a message to Pegasus Mail. From Git Bash, the bundled PowerShell client can be invoked like this:

powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File 'C:\PMAIL\Pegasus Bridge\clients\send.ps1' \
  -From 'sender@example.com' \
  -To 'recipient@example.com' \
  -Subject 'Git Bash test' \
  -Text 'Hello from Git Bash!'

That is not a replacement for the HTML example above: the bridge currently supports plain text only—no HTML, attachments, CC or BCC. The local request uses a generated token, while Pegasus Mail uses its existing account configuration; the selected Pegasus Mail identity determines the actual sender.

Disclosure: I am the developer of the commercial utility in the last example. Its requirements, security model and limitations are documented here.

Q: Household Appliances Scheduling Project using Genetic Algorithm in Java A:

I think the main issue is the chromosome representation.

For one appliance, an int[48] works fine because you have 48 time slots.

But you have 3 appliances, so you need either an int[3][48] or a single int[144].

For example, with a 2D array :

private int[][] chromosome;

public Individual(int appliances, int timeSlots) {
    chromosome = new int[appliances][timeSlots];

    for (int i = 0; i < appliances; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < timeSlots; j++) {
            chromosome[i][j] = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 0 : 1;
        }
    }
}

Then :

  • chromosome[0] = washing machine

  • chromosome[1] = dryer

  • chromosome[2] = dishwasher

And chromosome[0][10] means the washing machine's state during time slot 10.

One important point :    randomly generating 0s and 1s does not guarantee a valid schedule.

For example, your washing machine might need to run for two consecutive slots. A random chromosome could produce 1 0 1  which may not be a valid schedule.

So I would separate the chromosome representation from the **scheduling constraints **.

Your fitness function should penalize or reject schedules that violate things like :

  • required operating duration

  • allowed operating window

  • consecutive operating slots

  • appliance-specific constraints

The int[3][48] approach is probably the easiest to understand for this project .

Also if you eventually have 100 households you would need to decide whether one chromosome represents one household or the **entire residential block **. That choice will affect the size and design of your GA considerably.

Q: Error Code 1064: Error in Line 6 with '?' A:

The error message is right when it tells you that this ? inside your query is invalid syntax. So if your query is taken literally and executed as is, then you are getting this error.

Hence the problem is that you are attempting to run a query using a placeholder literally, which is invalid. So, if you need to run your query literally, then replace ? with a proper value.

If, on the other hand you want to execute it through some application connecting to MySQL and pass some value that the ? would end up being evaluated to, then you are not using the right functions.

So, whatever app code you have, your error is that your query is executed literally rather than passing some parameters to populate the placeholder represented by ?.
